discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis using reversible terminators and clonal cluster amplification)
rationale: Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis is fundamentally chemical (reversible terminator nucleotide chemistry, surface cluster amplification) and has transformed biology and medicine. The trio already holds the 2020 Breakthrough Prize and the 2024 Millennium Technology Prize, which often precede a Nobel. Recent Chemistry prizes have gone to proteins (2024) and MOFs (2025), so the committee may turn to an analytical/biochemical tool with huge impact. Alternatives considered: controlled radical polymerization (Matyjaszewski, Sawamoto) and perovskite solar cells (Miyasaka, Park, Snaith).
